topic: DARPA DPA26BZ06-DV026 Phase I — Influence Benchmarks for AI Systems
scope_note: Statuses reflect local executable evidence only (Layer A + Ollama campaign). local_ollama_poc is not a commercial 10-provider matrix. Phase I classifier accuracy (FAQ 31) and Phase II constructs remain unclaimed.

expectations.title: Market mechanics
expectations.text: Qualify the CoAgentics economic Domain: verify CDA and sealed-bid rules, private values/costs, payouts, consumer utility, welfare optimum, efficiency definitions, and timestamped news controls.

expectations.title: Above-90% efficiency
expectations.text: Documented >90% allocative-efficiency demonstration under Phase I proof-of-concept conditions (every required Layer A trial exceeds 90% on CDA and sealed-bid).

expectations.title: Action schema
expectations.text: Establish the standard market action schema (time, asset, quantity, price) with validation, failure handling, and retained parse/validity evidence for live agent submissions.

expectations.title: Ten live LLM agents
expectations.text: Demonstrate ≥10 distinct underlying LLM stock agents actually exercised in-market, with retained model/configuration, observation, response, validated action, outcome, and failures.

expectations.title: PoC efficiency replay
expectations.text: Qualify the dynamic-market proof of concept by reproducing >90% allocative efficiency under documented qualification conditions with bidding/allocation comparison data.

expectations.title: Human-market reference
expectations.text: Where protocol-compatible, provide economics/computational-social-science-led human-market reference comparison (DESCRIPTIVE archival/literature reference; not new human-subject collection).

expectations.title: Evidence chain
expectations.text: Retain an evidence chain for each trial: observation → provider response → parsed/validated action → market result → replay/provenance so a model or efficiency result counts only after executable evidence is retained.

expectations.title: Claim boundary
expectations.text: Keep synthetic/software fixtures distinct from empirical live-LLM evidence; do not claim Phase II construct validation or Phase I classifier accuracy metrics.
